description: Compare product prices between two online stores to find price gaps, spreads, and margin differences. Use it for questions like "compare prices between allbirds.com and allbirds.co.uk", "find the price gap for hoodies between two stores", or "which store sells this item cheaper?". Pass source_store and target_store web addresses. Supports cross-currency comparison: when stores quote in different currencies, prices are normalized using European Central Bank (ECB) daily reference rates via Frankfurter (https://api.frankfurter.dev, checked 2026-10-02). Optional filters: target_currency (defaults to target store currency), fx_rate (manual override), shipping_allowance (freight cost deduction), duty_allowance, include_landed_duty (EU flat customs duty), query (text in title/brand/category), match_by ("title", "sku", "handle", default "title"), and min_gap_pct (minimum percentage difference, default 0). Returns matched products with local and converted prices, exchange rate, rate date and source, price gaps, percentage spreads, stock availability, canonical links, and landed margin differences.

duty_allowance.description: Optional flat customs duty allowance per item in target currency to deduct for net landed margin evaluation. When omitted and include_landed_duty is true, defaults to EU flat duty (€3 converted to target currency).

fx_rate.description: Optional manual exchange rate override (source store currency to target currency). When omitted, fetched from ECB reference rates.

include_landed_duty.description: Whether to include estimated EU low-value consignment duty under Council Regulation (EU) 2026/382 for margin estimation.

match_by.description: Product attribute to match on: "title" (normalized title), "sku", or "handle" (default "title").

min_gap_pct.description: Minimum percentage price gap required to include a matched product (e.g. 15 for 15% spread). Default 0.

query.description: Optional text filter for product title, brand, or category, such as "runner" or "sneaker".

shipping_allowance.description: Optional estimated flat shipping allowance per item in target currency to deduct for net landed margin evaluation. Default 0.

source_store.description: Web address of the benchmark store, such as "mysneakerstore.com" or "https://store-a.myshopify.com".

target_currency.description: Optional 3-letter ISO currency code to normalize prices into, such as "USD", "EUR", "GBP" or "JPY". Defaults to target store currency.

target_store.description: Web address of the comparison store, such as "allbirds.com" or "https://boutique-b.com".

name: compare_store_prices
title: Compare prices and find gaps across stores
